title: https action
description: Calls an HTTPS endpoint with the message; the response becomes the message.

httpMethod.title: HTTP method
httpMethod.description: The body is sent with POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE

authMethod.title: Authentication
authMethod.description: None, or Basic with authUsername and authPassword (MutualSSL is not supported yet)

authPassword.title: Password
authPassword.description: Password for Basic authentication; may be an ENC(...) value

authenticationPreemptive.title: Preemptive authentication
authenticationPreemptive.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect, Basic credentials always go with the first request

mutualTls.title: Mutual TLS
mutualTls.description: Not supported yet: true is rejected

sslContextParameters.title: SSL context
sslContextParameters.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect, the trust store options decide whom to trust

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds the whole call may take

maxTotalConnections.title: Maximum connections
maxTotalConnections.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

connectionsPerRoute.title: Connections per host
connectionsPerRoute.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

retryRequests.title: Retry requests
retryRequests.description: Retry a call that cannot connect or that the server answers with 503, retryAttempts times, retryInterval ms apart

retryAttempts.title: Retry attempts
retryAttempts.description: With retryRequests: how many times to retry

excludeHeaders.title: Exclude headers
excludeHeaders.description: Regular expression for the names of the headers not to send, not case sensitive: hello|goodbye

throwExceptionOnFailure.title: Fail on error status
throwExceptionOnFailure.description: Fail the message when the response status is 400 or higher

useErrorRoute.title: Use error route
useErrorRoute.description: Same as throwExceptionOnFailure (the designer's name); either one fails the message on an error status, so that the error route handles it

useCustomDateHeader.title: Custom date header
useCustomDateHeader.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect, a date header of the message is always sent as it is
